title: Serious order execution
text:
Extremely disappointing experience with this broker. I have lost thousands of rupees due to what appears to be an issue with order execution.
Orders are getting executed even though the price shown on the chart and the market depth does not appear to have reached my placed order price. This is extremely concerning, especially when trading involves real money and even a small difference in execution can result in significant losses.
I have personally suffered thousands of rupees in losses because of these executions. When the chart and market depth show that the specified price was not reached, an order should not be executed at that price without a clear and verifiable explanation.
A trading platform must provide accurate, transparent, and reliable order execution. Traders cannot be expected to trust a broker when their orders appear to be executed at prices that are not reflected in the displayed market data.
I strongly recommend that the broker investigate these executions, provide complete order/exchange execution details, and explain why the orders were triggered despite the displayed price not reaching the specified level.

text:
Hi Zerodha Team,

It would be extremely helpful if Kite could support trailing stop loss and trailing target functionality directly within regular order placement. Currently, users have to manually modify orders, which becomes difficult during fast market movements.

Suggested features:
- Trailing Stop Loss based on points or percentage  
- Trailing Target (profit lock-in as price moves favorably)  
- Ability to set both SL and Target together with trailing option  
- Applicable for intraday as well as delivery orders  
- Optional toggle inside bracket / GTT / regular orders  

This feature would significantly improve risk management and reduce the need for constant monitoring, especially for active traders.

Many modern trading platforms already provide trailing exits, and having this in Kite would make order execution much more efficient.

Please consider adding this in a future update.
